why_this_rate: The rate every part copied here was drawn at on its own type; a chain of parts drawn at one rate has to be drawn at that rate.
what_varies: The flanger balances against the drive's panned output, so the drive is on both of its paths; the tone pair is on the chain's input, ahead of the drive.

fixed_rows.40 03 05: Amp: the four fixed responses the amp claim publishes as a readout, with no filter identified for any of them.
fixed_rows.40 03 06: Amp Sw: puts that response after the drive. Off at power-on.

nodes.why_oversample: Drawn at the model's rate with nothing raised: a DSP of the period runs its curve at its own clock, so what the curve puts above half of it folds back, and that is part of what is drawn.
